description: Paul Wacker is a dedicated Christian Conservative. He running to be a strong advocate for the preservation of our American freedoms and to be a voice for the people of Senate District 25. Paul will promote policies that prioritize Iowa workers, Iowa farmers, and Iowa families. He is committed to preserving what makes Iowa a truly unique and remarkable place to call home. Paul is asking for your vote to be the next Senator for Iowa Senate District 25. Vote for Paul Wacker on November 3rd.
